build_tf_example_parser: build a parser function from raw tf.train.Example using ExampleParserBuilder to parse features into a features dictionary
build_tf_sequence_example_parser: build a parser function from raw tf.train.SequenceExample using SequenceExampleParserBuilder to parse context and sequence features
build_preprocessor_pipeline: build a preprocessing pipeline using PreprocessorBuilder to add crop, resize, and pad functions for video frames
build_filter_pipeline: build a filter function using FilterBuilder to add filter functions for each data processing phase
build_decoder_pipeline: build a decode function using DecoderBuilder to transform raw features like JPEG strings into usable RGB tensors
